title: Ceiling Share on Expedited Charges for Long-Held and High-Value Pieces
content:
# Tariff Rider: The Ceiling Share on Expedited Charges for Long-Held and High-Value Pieces

This rider fixes the share of the ceiling that caps what may be charged for expedited handling on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service. It turns on two records: how long the piece has been in the chain's hands, and the value it is carried at set against the level's stone release threshold.

Where the time in the chain's hands is compared with the level's target turnaround, that target turnaround is counted in calendar days, taking 7 calendar days to 5 working days.

| The piece has been in the chain's hands longer than the level's target turnaround | The piece is carried above the level's stone release threshold | The ceiling share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the wide ceiling share, 40 percent |
| yes | no | the standard ceiling share, 30 percent |
| no | yes | the standard ceiling share, 30 percent |
| no | no | the share is not widened on these grounds |

**The rider in words.** Where the piece has been in the chain's hands longer than the level's target turnaround and it is carried above the level's stone release threshold, the ceiling share is the wide ceiling share of 40 percent; where exactly one of those two holds — the piece held longer than that turnaround and carried at or below that threshold, or carried above that threshold and held no longer than that turnaround — the ceiling share is the standard ceiling share of 30 percent. In any other case the share is not widened on these grounds.

**On the two records.** The time in the chain's hands is counted from the day the piece was taken in over the counter to the handling date. The value the piece is carried at is the figure the work order holds it at, and it must stand above the level's stone release threshold, not merely at it.

**A hypothetical reading.** At a level whose target turnaround is 14 business days, that target counted in calendar days comes to 19.6 calendar days, and whose stone release threshold is 2500.00 USD: a piece held 30 days and carried at 4,000.00 USD falls under the wide ceiling share of 40 percent; held 30 days and carried at 2,000.00 USD, the standard 30 percent; held 10 days and carried at 4,000.00 USD, the standard 30 percent; held 10 days and carried at 2,500.00 USD, the share is not widened, that value being at and not above the threshold.
